title: Ordinary evaluation chain calculation
statement: Let Y be a scheme and P,F arbitrary module-sheaf cochain complexes. Put O equal to the single tensor unit and V=Hom(P,O). Let f:Tot(F tensor V) to Hom(P,F) satisfy the scheme-site component formula [def-pc-scheme-ordinary-evaluation-formula]. Let eta be the fixed K-injective augmentation and U the explicitly constructed uncurrying [lem-pc-tensor-hom-uncurry-differential]. Then there is a chain map e:Tot(V tensor P) to O such that U(Hom(P,eta_O))=e;eta_O and U(f;Hom(P,eta_F))=schemeTensorUnitAction(F,V,P,e);eta_F, where the tensor action is [def-pc-scheme-tensor-unit-action]. The Hom projections used to construct e are those of [lem-sc-hom-complex-projections], with the closed sheaf tensor [lem-pc-sheaf-modules-tensor-closed]. No derived-category assumption, flatness or boundedness is required.

theorem schemeOrdinaryEvaluation_chain_calculation (Y : Scheme.{u})
    (P F : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (f : pullbackTensorTotal Y F
        (homComplex (R := Y.sheaf) P
          ((HomologicalComplex.single _ (.up ℤ) 0).obj
            (𝟙_ (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))))) ⟶
      homComplex (R := Y.sheaf) P F)
    (hf : IsSchemeOrdinaryEvaluation Y P F f) :
    letI := SheafOfModules.isGrothendieckAbelian (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)
    let O := (HomologicalComplex.single _ (.up ℤ) 0).obj
      (𝟙_ (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)))
    let V := homComplex (R := Y.sheaf) P O
    let eta := CochainComplex.toKInjectiveResolution.{u}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))
    let phiF := f ≫ ((homComplexFunctor (R := Y.sheaf)).obj (op P)).map (eta.app F)
    let phiO := ((homComplexFunctor (R := Y.sheaf)).obj (op P)).map (eta.app O)
    ∃ e : pullbackTensorTotal Y V P ⟶ O,
      schemeTensorHomUncurry Y V P O phiO = e ≫ eta.app O ∧
      schemeTensorHomUncurry Y (pullbackTensorTotal Y F V) P F phiF =
        schemeTensorUnitAction Y F V P e ≫ eta.app F
